context: WebGL force-directed network tech demo — 50K nodes, 80K edges, 8 communities rendered as a galaxy-like particle simulation
first_impression: Striking galaxy aesthetic with ring-shaped community clusters on deep navy, the Paul Tol muted palette producing genuine color harmony across 8 communities.
what_works: Deliberate use of Paul Tol's muted qualitative palette rather than schemeCategory10 — colors are distinguishable without being garish. The dark #0a0a1a background paired with soft per-node glow via fragment shader creates a coherent space/galaxy metaphor that the title earns.
what_doesnt: Title 'WebGL Force Galaxy' is rendered in #556 — nearly invisible against the dark background, a concrete legibility failure for the one piece of text meant to orient the viewer. Legend at 11px with no visual separation from the canvas edge feels like an afterthought rather than a designed UI element.
